functions.name: baalz.lua
functions.sourceReview: Read the complete upstream dat/baalz.lua program (lines 1-66). The loader preserves solidfill initialization, mazelevel/corrmaze flags, right alignment and trailing map spaces, both level-relative levregions and the excluded stair-up/branch/teleport area, non-diggable selection, stocked westward mazewalk, fixed stair and locked door, and every fixed and random object, trap, and monster descriptor in source order. All descriptor callees are implemented by js/mklev.js and js/themerooms.js; no unported callee or placeholder remains in this Lua program.

callers.source: The special-level registry dynamically imports baalz_levels.js and spreads BAALZ_LEVEL_LOADERS into SPECIAL_LEVEL_LOADERS, making the Lua program available under the baalz proto name.
sp_lev.c load_special() resolves SPECIAL_LEVEL_LOADERS[name], creates the special-level descriptor API, invokes the baalz loader, and runs finish() post-processing.
mkmaze.c makemaz() resolves the baalz special-level proto and calls load_special() during makelevel() when Is_special() selects Baalzebub's level.

entryPointReview: The selected whole Lua program has one entry point: mkmaze.c makemaz() selects the baalz proto, load_special() dispatches the registered loader, and the descriptor API executes the complete dat/baalz.lua program. The Baalzebub wizard-mode teleport recipe reaches this dispatch and records the resulting full level-generation trace.
